metadata.issueBody:
## Summary

Replace retiring gemini-3.8-flash-high in AGY design-critique critic seat before Nov 30, 2026 sunset

## Context

Internal benchmark evidence (private), Directive 0.131.5. Per Google Antigravity official docs (antigravity.google/docs/models.md), Gemini 3.8 Flash (along with Gemini 4 Argon, Claude 4.6, and GPT-OSS-120b) is scheduled for removal on November 30, 2026.

## Expected behavior

Update AGY_CRITIC_MODEL, AGY_PONG_ARGV, and AGY_SHORT_POINTER_ARGV in panel-seat-families (and any related docs/tests) to a surviving post-Nov-30 Antigravity model ID before November 30, 2026 — for example gemini-4-hydrogen-high (available on all Antigravity plans including Free, Plus, Pro, Ultra, and Enterprise) or gemini-4-carbon-high / gemini-4-neon-high for paid tiers.

## Actual behavior / gap

In Directive 0.131.5, vendor/directive-core/dist/design-critique/panel-seat-families.js hard-codes AGY_CRITIC_MODEL = gemini-3.8-flash-high as well as --model gemini-3.8-flash-high in AGY_PONG_ARGV and AGY_SHORT_POINTER_ARGV. After November 30, 2026, the agy critic seat pong and dispatch commands will fail against a removed model.

## Session notes

Evidence: internal benchmark evidence (private). Related issues: Refs #7245, #7332.

---
_Filed via `deft feedback:file` from a directive consumer project (Refs #1709 value-feedback gap escalation)._

expected_outputs: agy critic seat pinned to gemini-4-hydrogen-high
